West Bengal Assembly Passes Bills on OBC Reservations and Public Safety

The West Bengal Assembly has passed two significant bills. One bill aims to revamp the Other Backward Classes (OBC) reservation framework, reportedly scrapping a TMC-era expansion and restoring a previous system. Another bill, focused on public safety, introduces measures to control anti-social activities and prevent organized crime. The passage of these bills marks a notable legislative development in the state.
